name: t4
description: t4 AI SDLC core: the ai/ layout (AGENTS.md, context docs, task prompts, reviewer / tester / architect / analyst agents and the explorer / specifier / planner / implementer step agents, fleet map), session/edit/usage logging hooks, dont-touch guard, adapter sync. Standalone — no dependency on any other repo and no runtime dependency; two optional task paths reach services a repo configures (a tracker, a read-only knowledge source), each inert where nothing is declared; framework overlays build on it through the template slots.
